title: Metric Resampler Agent for Inference KPIs and OTel/Prom Export
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Inference nodes generate a high-cardinality stream of raw metrics and labels (model, route, prompt-type, tenant, sdk-version, latency buckets). Sending these verbatim to both Prometheus (remote_write) and OTLP causes excessive cardinality, privacy surface (raw prompt hints), and variable telemetry costs. We need an adaptive agent that sits on inference nodes (or as a lightweight daemonset) to perform: canonicalization of labels, redaction of prompt-derived PII, deterministic resampling and prioritization of error/slow traces into higher-sampling bins, and export to both OTLP and Prometheus-friendly rollups. Goal: reduce downstream cardinality and cost while preserving SLO-aligned visibility for latency/error KPIs and enabling trace-links for debugging. The agent must be resilient to backpressure, support schema version negotiation, and be compatible with our existing tracing hooks and KPI tag conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Agent (binary/container) deployed as a daemonset on test cluster that receives local metric stream and exports to an OTLP gateway and Prometheus remote_write endpoint
End-to-end latency KPIs (p50/p95/p99 per-route) remain within 2% of baseline when agent is enabled (measured over 24h load test)
Cardinality reduction: unique metric label combinations for model+route reduced by >=60% at the remote store while preserving top-100 slow and top-100 error routes
PII redaction: any label or metric originating from prompt text is scrubbed or hashed; unit tests for known prompt patterns pass
Resampling deterministic: same request attributes produce same sampling decision for 72h window (seeded hashing), enabling reproducible debugging
Schema negotiation: agent supports schema v1 and v2 with a graceful fallback (logs a specific audit event on mismatch)
Integration tests covering Prometheus remote_write success/failure and OTLP exporter backoff behavior
Documentation and runbook updated with rollout plan and fallback toggle (feature flag)
tasks: Design: finalize label canonicalization rules and resampling policy (latency buckets, error prioritization)
Prototype: build a lightweight Go agent that ingests /metrics and traces hooks and applies transformation pipeline
Tests: unit tests for redaction, sampling determinism, and label mapping
Integration: wiring agent to OTLP gateway (staging) and Prometheus remote_write target
Load test: run 24h comparison against baseline traffic using infra toolkit
Dashboard: create a comparison dashboard showing cardinality, cost delta, and KPI fidelity
Rollout: staged feature flag rollout (canary -> region -> global) with automatic rollback on SLI regression
Docs: developer guide for adding new canonicalization rules and schema migration notes
